rows.ja: 提携・ライセンス・顧客

relations.text: エンドポイントICのウエハーを発注書ベースで発注しており、TSMCとの長期供給契約はない
relations.text_en: Impinj orders endpoint IC wafers on a purchase-order basis with no long-term supply agreement with TSMC

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: We order endpoint IC wafers on a purchase-order basis and do not have a long-term supply agreement with TSMC.

relations.text: リーダーICのウエハーも発注書ベースで発注しており、TSMCとの長期供給契約はない
relations.text_en: Reader IC wafers are likewise ordered on a purchase-order basis with no long-term supply agreement with TSMC

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: We order our reader IC wafers on a purchase-order basis and do not have a long-term supply agreement with TSMC.

relations.text: ImpinjとIntelの間に2008年7月3日付のライセンス契約がある
relations.text_en: Impinj lists a License Agreement with Intel Corporation dated July 3, 2008

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: License Agreement, dated July 3, 2008, between the registrant and Intel Corporation

relations.text: ImpinjがGoogle、Intel、Smartracとともに RAIN Allianceを共同設立した
relations.text_en: Impinj cofounded the RAIN Alliance along with Google, Intel and Smartrac

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: We spearheaded developing the RAIN air-interface standard, lobbied governments to allocate frequency spectrum and, along with Google, Intel and Smartrac, cofounded the RAIN Alliance.

companies.name: マイクロチップ・テクノロジー

relations.text: 2025年12月22日にMicrochip Technologyと物品・サービス契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On December 22, 2025, Impinj signed a goods and services agreement with Microchip Technology

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: On December 22, 2025, we signed a goods and services agreement with Microchip Technology Incorporated, of which a member of our board of directors holds both an executive leadership and board of directors position.

companies.name: エイブリィ・デニソン

relations.text: Avery Dennisonの食品小売向けRFIDインレイ「AD IdentiFresh」は、ImpinjのM800シリーズICを活用している
relations.text_en: Avery Dennison's AD IdentiFresh RFID inlay series for food retail leverages Impinj's M800 series ICs

source.label: Impinj website
source.quote: Avery Dennison launches AD IdentiFresh™ to unlock efficiency, freshness and waste reduction in food retail RFID inlay series builds on breakthrough innovation in bakery, meat, deli and produce, leveraging Impinj's M800 series ICs
source.note: Avery Dennisonによる2026年2月の発表で、Impinjのサイトに掲載されています。
source.note_en: Avery Dennison's February 2026 announcement, published on Impinj's website.

relations.text: ImpinjはNXPを主要なエンドポイントICの競合と位置づけている
relations.text_en: Impinj calls NXP its primary endpoint IC competitor

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: We currently derive a substantial share of our licensing revenue from NXP, our primary endpoint IC competitor, based on our Settlement Agreement with them.

relations.text: Impinjのライセンス収入の相当部分は、NXPとの和解契約に基づくものである
relations.text_en: A substantial share of Impinj's licensing revenue comes from NXP under their Settlement Agreement

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: We currently derive a substantial share of our licensing revenue from NXP, our primary endpoint IC competitor, based on our Settlement Agreement with them.

relations.text: NXPの年次報告が、Impinjとの和解と係争の解決を記している
relations.text_en: NXP's annual report describes the settlement with Impinj resolving all outstanding litigation

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: (“Impinj”) entered into a settlement agreement with the Company paying Impinj an immaterial cash consideration, resolving all outstanding litigation and other proceedings between the parties, with all previously pending litigation and administrative proceedings being dismissed.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
